about: The web's copy of the Ark's shared position module and its data. positions.ts is byte-identical to AnimalDex's; atlas.json is generated here (scripts/ark-positions-atlas.mts) and copied there; contract.json is generated there (scripts/ark/positions-contract.ts). src/lib/ark-positions.test.ts checks these hashes and every contract case. sleep.json (version 4) is generated there (scripts/ark/generate_sleep_hours.py) and copied here. Change all four together, in both repos.

forestry.about: p5 humans (AnimalDex decision 379): forestry.ts and forest-stands.json are byte-identical to AnimalDex supabase/functions/_shared/ark-positions/ (branch ark-humans-decisions 543f6c02f). forest-stands.json is generated here (scripts/ark-forest-stands.mts) and copied there. Change both together, in both repos.
